codeReview.summary: The fix adequately addresses the prior blocking regression. Compared to the failed feature commit (e9dd499), this fix aligns frontend and backend handshake auth by sending userId on the SockJS URL and parsing it server-side (with header fallback), restoring authenticated browser connectivity while still rejecting missing/invalid/non-existent user IDs.
